spans.s:
n. (-यं)
Water.
E.
तु to surround, Uṇādi affix कोय or ताय to nourish, अच् affix, and आ changed irregularly to ओ.

m. (-मः)
A sort of cane growing in or near water, (Calamus fasciculatus, Rox.)
E.
तोय water, and काम desiring, affecting.

m. (-च्छ्रः)
A sort of penance, drinking nothing but water for a fixed period.
E.
तोय water, and कच्छ्र penance.

m. (-म्भः)
Hail.
E.
तोय water, and डिम्भ young; also तायडिम्भक.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Who or what gives water.
m. (-दः)
1 A cloud.
2 A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.)
n. (-दं)
Ghee or oiled butter.
E.
तोय water, and द yielding.

mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं)
Having or containing water.
m. (-रः)
1 A cloud.
2 A fragrant grass: see मुस्तक.
3 A potherb, (Marsilia dentata.)
E.
तोय water, and धर possessing.

m. (-धिः)
The ocean.
E.
तोय water, and धि having.

m. (-यः)
Cloves.
E.
तोयधि the sea, and प्रिय fond of; produced in maritime countries.

m. (-धिः)
The ocean.
E.
तोय water, and निधि nest or receptacle.

f. (-ली)
A plant, (Jussieua repens.)
E.
तोय water, and पिप्पली long pepper.

f. (-ष्पी)
Trumpet flower.
E.
तोय water, and पुष्प a flower; flowering near water.

n. (-नं)
The clearing nut plant, (Strychnos potatorum.)
E.
तोय water, and प्रसादन clearing, cleansing; the nut being rubbed upon the inside of a water jar, occasions the precipitation of the impurities of the water poured into it.

n. (-लं)
The clearing nut: see the preceding.
E.
तोयप्रसादन as above, and फल fruit.

f. (-ल्ली)
A kind of gourd, (Momordica charantia.)
E.
तोय water, and वल्ली a creeper.

f. (-का)
An oyster.
E.
तोय, and शुक्तिका an oyster.

m. (-कः)
A frog.
E.
तोय water, and सूचक a spy.

f. (-नी)
Trumpet flower.
E.
तोय water, अधि upon or near, वस to abide, णिनि and ङीप् affs.
